metadata.rules_text:
- Overestimate prices after recent spikes; model tends to overshoot post-peak sentiment (e.g., +0.5–1.0σ above true) when sentiment is positive or neutral.
- Underestimate when sentiment is strongly negative (e.g., < -0.5) — model fails to account for downward pressure.
- Lag in response to sentiment shifts: model reacts 1–2 days too late to sentiment turning points.
- Mean reversion bias: model overweights recent highs and underweights lows; correct by smoothing with 3–5 day moving average of sentiment-adjusted history.
- Horizon-specific error: 30-day forecasts overestimate volatility in high-sentiment periods; reduce forecast magnitude by 5–15% when sentiment > 0.3.
- Avoid “sentiment echo” — if sentiment is negative for 3+ consecutive days, suppress upward forecast momentum even if price is rising.
